verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for an equity-management SaaS like Ledgy, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The bulk workflow automation and automated error flags are rule-based features, not an AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
